genre.puzzle.h1: Brain games: puzzles, logic and mazes
genre.puzzle.titre_seo: Free puzzle, logic and maze games for kids to play online
genre.puzzle.description_seo: Brain teasers, pieces to put back in place, logic riddles and mazes with a hidden exit: free games for kids on a phone, tablet or PC, then offline.
genre.puzzle.intro: Here, you play with your head rather than with fast fingers. You put pieces back where they belong, slide blocks, connect shapes, find the only solution that works or guide a character to the exit of a maze without getting lost in the dead ends. Most of the time there's no rush: you can look, try, make mistakes and start again as many times as you like. With each riddle you solve, your reasoning gets stronger, and so does your patience; you also learn to picture things in space and to plan one move ahead. Some brain teasers can be solved from age 4 or 5, while others give players aged 9 and up a real challenge. A tip for when you're stuck: explain out loud what you've already tried, or trace the path with your finger first, without playing.

genre.memoire.titre_seo: Free memory and observation games for kids to play online
genre.memoire.description_seo: Find the matching pairs, remember sequences, spot the hidden objects: free memory and observation games on a phone, tablet or PC, then offline too.
genre.memoire.intro: Turn over two cards and remember what they were hiding, repeat a sequence of colors or sounds, find objects tucked away in a picture or spot the differences between two almost identical drawings: here, your eyes and your memory work as a team. At first there's only a little to remember or look for, then the list grows and the scenes fill up with details. Working memory, visual attention and concentration get sharper, and you learn to examine a picture methodically, corner by corner. Since there's little to read, simple picture pairs and small scenes suit kids from 3 or 4; older ones will be more interested in beating their record. Pass the screen around at each turn and the game becomes a little challenge at home, and the grown-up doesn't always win.

genre.quiz.titre_seo: Free quizzes for kids: general knowledge trivia questions
genre.quiz.description_seo: Test your general knowledge one question at a time on a phone, tablet or computer: free trivia quizzes for kids that you can replay offline later.
genre.quiz.intro: A quiz is a question, several possible answers and a moment of suspense before you find out if you got it right. Questions can be about nature, countries, animals, sports, history or everyday life. Getting it wrong is no big deal: an answer you discover after a mistake often sticks better in your memory. You need to read carefully and think before you choose, and your curiosity grows with every round of questions. These games are mainly for independent readers, around 7 or 8; for younger kids, a grown-up can read the questions out loud and team up with the child. And when a question stumps you, why not look up the answer together in a book or a dictionary?

genre.mots.titre_seo: Free online word and letter games for kids: spelling fun
genre.mots.description_seo: Put the letters in order, guess the hidden word: free letter and vocabulary games on a phone, tablet or PC, which you can then play offline.
genre.mots.intro: With word and letter games, language becomes a playground. You put letters in the right order, guess a hidden word, complete a sentence or hunt for words in a grid. Without feeling like you're doing schoolwork, you learn to recognize letters, spell words better and build your vocabulary. Games where you catch or match letters support the first steps in reading, from age 4 or 5; longer grids and rarer words will appeal to readers aged 9 and up. An unfamiliar word you come across during a game can become the word of the day, which everyone at home tries to slip into a sentence before evening.

genre.calcul.titre_seo: Free online math games for kids: counting and times tables
genre.calcul.description_seo: Count, add up, practice your times tables: free math and number games for kids on a tablet, phone or PC, and playable offline after your first game.
genre.calcul.intro: In these games, numbers become things to pick up, coins to give as change, boxes to fill in or a race against the clock. Counting, adding up to reach the right total, comparing two numbers, solving a little problem: each right answer moves the game forward, and math becomes very concrete. Mental math, number sense and reasoning improve through repetition. Around 4 or 5, you start by counting and recognizing digits; times tables and bigger calculations usually come from age 7 or 8. A few short, regular sessions are better than one long session that wears you out, and a sum from the game is easy to redo with real objects, like pasta or buttons.

genre.arcade.titre_seo: Free arcade and reflex games for kids: quick to learn
genre.arcade.description_seo: Catch, dodge, aim and tap the target before it gets away: free arcade and reflex games for kids on a phone, tablet or PC, and offline afterwards.
genre.arcade.intro: Arcade games keep the spirit of the game machines of the past: a rule you understand in a few seconds, a game that starts right away, and the urge to start again to get a little further. Everything often happens in a split second. You catch what's falling, dodge, bounce, aim at a target or a bubble, or on the contrary hold your finger back when you mustn't touch. No realistic violence: you aim at balloons, targets or objects. Speed, coordination between your eyes and your finger and a cool head improve from level to level, as the pace gently picks up. Little text and simple controls: most of these games are easy to pick up around age 4 or 5. They're intense: after a few rounds, a break to catch your breath does you good.

genre.plateforme.titre_seo: Free platform games for kids: run, jump and climb online
genre.plateforme.description_seo: Run, jump over the gaps and climb to the finish: platform games played by finger on phones and tablets or with the keyboard on PC, then offline.
genre.plateforme.intro: Your character runs, jumps and climbs through a world full of obstacles. The goal: reach the end of the level without falling into gaps or touching traps, collecting shiny things along the way. It's all about timing. Jump too early or too late, and you have to start over, a little smarter than the time before. Attempt after attempt, your moves become more precise, you learn to anticipate and you discover what it means to persevere. These games often appeal from age 6 or 7, when handling several controls at once comes easily. Missing a jump is part of the game: every fall teaches you where to put your feet next time.

genre.course.titre_seo: Free racing games for kids: beat the clock on every track
genre.course.description_seo: Take the bends at the right moment and speed toward the finish line: free racing games for kids on a phone, tablet or PC, even offline later.
genre.course.intro: First across the finish line or faster than the clock: that's the goal. Depending on the game, you drive a vehicle, make an animal gallop or run yourself, taking each bend carefully and avoiding whatever slows you down. You discover the track as you go, and each attempt helps you spot the best lines. Reflexes, anticipation and control of small movements, by finger or keyboard, get sharper lap after lap. Races where you only need to steer suit kids from 5 or 6; more technical courses are aimed more at ages 8 and up. A good driver knows the track by heart: running the same course again to shave off a few tenths of a second teaches you to improve step by step.

genre.aventure.titre_seo: Free adventure and role-playing games for kids online
genre.aventure.description_seo: Explore unknown lands, help your hero grow quest after quest and solve riddles: free adventure games for kids on a phone, tablet or computer.
genre.aventure.intro: What lies beyond the next passage? In an adventure game, curiosity keeps you moving. You explore an island, a forest, caves or a faraway kingdom, meet characters, pick up objects and find out where each one becomes useful. In role-playing games, your hero grows along with you: they gain experience, new talents and better equipment, and the choices made at the start shape what follows. Encounters with creatures are settled by skill or cunning, with no realistic violence. Logic, reading, decision-making and perseverance are needed at every step. These games are mainly for kids who read on their own, around 6 or 7. The urge to play “just one more quest” is strong: it's best to agree on how long to play before starting.

genre.strategie.titre_seo: Free strategy and board games for kids who think ahead
genre.strategie.description_seo: Place your towers, anticipate your opponent's moves, play with cards and pieces: free strategy games for kids on a phone, tablet or PC, then offline.
genre.strategie.intro: Luck counts for little: here, everything depends on the decisions you make. You place your pieces, choose which way to go, make the best use of what you have and try to guess what your opponent is planning. In defense games, a line of little intruders marches toward your castle or your garden: it's up to you to set up towers and guards in the right places, wave after wave, to push them back or put them to sleep. Board and card games have their place too, with their dice, pieces and draw piles. Thinking several moves ahead, managing resources and changing plans when the situation shifts: that's what these games train. They're aimed more at kids aged 7 or 8, although some can be played from 6. No game is played against strangers: you take on the computer.

genre.simulation.titre_seo: Free care, simulation and management games for kids
genre.simulation.description_seo: Care for an animal, bake cakes, run a shop or a farm: free simulation and management games for kids on a phone, tablet or PC, then playable offline.
genre.simulation.intro: Taking the place of someone who looks after others, doing a real job or running your own business: that's the heart of these games. You can feed, brush and care for an animal, bandage a small scrape, bake cakes, or run a shop, a farm, a restaurant or a whole town. Then you serve customers, harvest, sell and decide how to use the game's money, which is always pretend. Real life is simplified and told with tenderness. Empathy, a sense of responsibility, organization and a first idea of budgeting develop naturally. From 4 or 5, you mostly move forward by tapping and dragging; businesses where you need to count and plan ahead suit kids from 7 or 8 better. For parents, it's a ready-made way into a chat about pocket money.

genre.creation.titre_seo: Free dress-up, coloring and building games for kids
genre.creation.description_seo: Dress up a character, color with your fingertip, build a tower that stays up: free creative games for kids on a phone, tablet or PC, then offline.
genre.creation.intro: You decide everything. Clothes and accessories for a character or an animal, the colors of a drawing, decorating a bedroom or a cake, a house, a bridge or a whole village to build block by block: these games give your ideas free rein. Very often there's no right or wrong answer; the fun is in trying combinations and creating something that feels like you. No pencil going over the lines, and you can change your mind as often as you like. Others offer challenges, like building a structure that's strong enough: then you have to test, fail and fix. Your eye for colors and shapes, your imagination and your sense of balance grow without you even thinking about it. Since you mostly play by tapping, kids aged 3 or 4 pick them up easily. Telling a grown-up about your creation afterwards extends the game.

genre.musique.titre_seo: Free music and rhythm games for kids: tap to the beat
genre.musique.description_seo: Tap to the beat, replay a melody, recognize the instruments: free music and rhythm games for kids on a phone, tablet or PC, then playable offline.
genre.musique.intro: These games are played with your ears as much as your fingers. You tap at the exact moment a note arrives, repeat a short melody in order, recognize an instrument or compose your own tune by choosing sounds. The tempo guides everything: stay in rhythm and the successes keep coming. Listening, memory for sounds and coordination improve together. Simple listening games suit kids around 4 or 5, while fast challenges appeal to older ones. It's best to play with the sound on, with headphones if needed. And when the screen goes off, the music goes on: singing or clapping together keeps the fun going.

univers.animaux.h1: Animal games: farm, savanna and pets
univers.animaux.titre_seo: Free animal games for kids: farm, savanna, dogs and cats
univers.animaux.description_seo: Cows and chicks, lions and giraffes, puppies and kittens: meet animals in free games for kids on a phone, tablet or PC, then play them offline.
univers.animaux.intro: In the farmyard, out on the savanna, deep in the forest or at home, animals are the heroes of these games. You feed the hens and count the chicks, watch lions, monkeys and squirrels in their homes, walk a dog or care for a kitten. The ways to play vary a lot: memory, puzzles, reflexes, racing or caring. Kids learn to recognize species, their sounds, their young and their habitat, and to understand that an animal has needs: eating, drinking, sleeping, being cared for. The animals are shown gently, with no frightening hunting scenes. Younger players love finding animals they already know; older ones discover faraway species. What about you: which animal would you love to see with your own eyes? Horses and ponies have their own page.

univers.chevaux.titre_seo: Free horse and pony games for kids: riding and grooming
univers.chevaux.description_seo: Brush, care for and dress up your pony, then gallop away: free horse riding games on a phone, tablet or computer that you can replay offline.
univers.chevaux.intro: The world of horses holds a special place for many kids, and it has its own page. The games take place at the stable, in the paddock or at the riding school: depending on the game, you get a pony ready and brush it, choose its outfit, feed it, gallop, clear jumps or answer riding quiz questions. Riding vocabulary slips in naturally (coat, mane, halter, trot, gallop), along with grooming routines and respect for the animal. Young riders and dreamers who have never been near a pony each have something to enjoy: the former will be proud to explain the words they recognize, the latter may discover a wish to try a first pony ride.

univers.dinosaures.titre_seo: Free dinosaur and prehistoric games for kids to play
univers.dinosaures.description_seo: Meet tyrannosaurs, triceratops and mammoths in free dinosaur games for kids on a phone, tablet or computer, then play them offline once opened.
univers.dinosaures.intro: Their size, their impressive names and the mystery of their disappearance: dinosaurs are fascinating. Everything here happens in their time, and more broadly in prehistory: volcanoes, giant ferns, eggs about to hatch, fossil digs, mammoths and early humans around the fire. Observation, memory or reflexes come into play, and a few species names end up sticking, as does the difference between herbivores and carnivores. The dinosaurs stay friendly: no menacing jaws or scary chases. A fact to impress everyone with: the great dinosaurs and the first humans never lived at the same time. More than sixty million years separate them.

univers.ocean.h1: Ocean and pirate games: fish, diving and treasure
univers.ocean.titre_seo: Free sea and pirate games for kids: fish and treasure
univers.ocean.description_seo: Fish, turtles and coral under the waves, treasure maps and pirate ships above: free sea games for kids on a phone, tablet or PC, then offline too.
univers.ocean.intro: Beneath the surface, the ocean hides a world of colors: coral reefs, schools of fish, jellyfish, octopuses, turtles and whales. Up top, pirates hoist the sails, read their map and search for the chest buried on a mysterious island. Swim between obstacles, explore a shipwreck, build a sandcastle before the tide comes in or follow a treasure map: depending on the game, the adventure happens underwater, on the beach or on the deck of a ship. These pirates are more pranksters than villains. You discover sea life, find your way (north, south, left, right) and realize along the way that a clean sea is a healthy sea. A little idea for home: hide an object, draw the map that leads to it and let the child follow it, like a real captain.

univers.nature.h1: Nature games: gardens, bugs and seasons
univers.nature.titre_seo: Free nature and season games for kids: gardens and bugs
univers.nature.description_seo: Sow, water, watch the insects and follow the seasons all the way to the winter holidays: free nature games for kids on a phone, tablet or PC, then offline.
univers.nature.intro: A seed sprouting, a bee gathering nectar, a forest changing color in the fall, a snowy village on the night of the presents: nature and the rhythm of the seasons are the subject of these games. Depending on the game, you garden, water, watch insects, listen to frogs, pick fruit in the orchard or fill a sack with presents. This theme welcomes calm games where you take your time as well as faster challenges. It helps you understand what a plant needs to grow, the role of pollinators, and how seasons and holidays come back year after year. Kids who like to observe and take care of things feel at home here. A pot of soil and a few radish seeds on the windowsill are then enough to see it all for real.

univers.fantasy.h1: Magic, monster and fairy tale games
univers.fantasy.titre_seo: Free magic and monster games for kids: fairies and dragons
univers.fantasy.description_seo: Fairies, wizards, dragons, funny monsters and fairy tale kingdoms: free magic games for kids on a phone, tablet or PC, which you can then play offline.
univers.fantasy.intro: Fairies, wizards, unicorns, dragons, fizzing potions and enchanted forests: here, magic is part of everyday life. You also meet monsters with floppy horns and spots of every color, funnier than they are scary, and heroes straight out of fairy tales and legends. You cast spells, mix strange ingredients, raise made-up creatures or travel through an imaginary kingdom. Behind this setting are games that are very different from one another: strategy, puzzles, defense, adventure or creation. The magic stays bright and cheerful, with no truly scary scenes; laughing at a strange creature even helps some kids tame their bedtime fears. A magic spell you made up, a monster drawn with its secret powers: the best follow-up to a game is often the one you imagine yourself.

univers.espace.h1: Space and robot games: rockets, planets and machines
univers.espace.titre_seo: Free space and robot games for kids: rockets and planets
univers.espace.description_seo: Fly a rocket, visit the planets, guide a robot step by step: free space and robot games for kids on a phone, tablet or PC, then offline as well.
univers.espace.intro: Rockets, astronauts, planets, space stations and helpful robots: off to the stars and the future. From one game to the next, you pilot a spaceship, hop from moon to moon, put the planets back in order or guide a robot step by step to the exit. Space suits fast reflex games just as well as calm puzzles; robots call for games where you plan a sequence of actions, spot a mistake and try again differently. It's a first introduction, without a single line of code, to the logic behind programming. Game after game, the order of the planets around the Sun or the difference between a star and a planet become familiar. To carry on without a screen, a grown-up can turn into a robot: the child “programs” them out loud (two steps forward, turn right).

univers.monde.h1: World and history games: countries, flags and eras
univers.monde.titre_seo: Free geography and history games for kids: flags and castles
univers.monde.description_seo: Flags, pyramids and castles: travel around the world and back in time with free games for kids on a phone, tablet or PC, then play them offline too.
univers.monde.intro: Where is Japan? Which flag has a maple leaf on it? How did people live in the days of the pharaohs or the knights? These games invite you to travel from one continent to another and from one era to the next. Place countries on a map, match flags, discover monuments and festivals from elsewhere, explore a pyramid or defend a castle: geography and history become games. Wars and dark times aren't shown; the focus is on daily life, discoveries and traditions. Curiosity, finding your way in space and time, and memory all get a workout, and future lessons will feel more familiar. The trickiest questions suit good readers, around age 8. At the end of the journey, one idea remains: the world is vast and varied, and it was built little by little.

univers.ville.titre_seo: Free job games for kids: firefighter, doctor, vet and more
univers.ville.description_seo: Firefighter, baker, vet or dentist: discover the jobs that keep a city running in free games for kids on a phone, tablet or computer, then offline.
univers.ville.intro: Who puts out fires, who treats dogs, who looks after our teeth, who bakes bread before dawn? The city and the people who keep it running are at the heart of these games. You take on a job, run a shop, direct traffic or help the residents of a neighborhood. Health jobs have their place too: playing doctor or dentist, you discover the human body and good habits, like brushing your teeth, with no upsetting images. Everyone's role, the vocabulary of jobs and the rules of living together (waiting your turn, crossing at the right place, helping out) start to make sense. The eternal question “what do you want to be when you grow up?” finds plenty of food for thought. A parent can also take the chance to describe their own work in simple words.

univers.vehicules.h1: Car, truck, train and plane games
univers.vehicules.titre_seo: Free vehicle games for kids: cars, trucks and planes
univers.vehicules.description_seo: Cars, tractors, trains, boats, planes and diggers: take the controls in free vehicle games for kids on a phone, tablet or computer, then offline too.
univers.vehicules.intro: Everything that rolls, flies or sails has its place here: race cars, fire trucks, buses, trains, boats, planes, helicopters and construction vehicles. Races, skill courses, traffic puzzles or building games: the ways to play vary. Driving around obstacles sharpens reflexes; parking a truck or organizing a crossroads gets you thinking about space and trajectories. Recognizing each vehicle and imitating its sound delights the youngest, while older kids go for the toughest courses. Traffic lights, crosswalks, seat belts fastened: these games also open the door to a first conversation about road safety.

univers.sport.h1: Games to discover sports and their rules
univers.sport.titre_seo: Free sports-themed games: rules, disciplines and records
univers.sport.description_seo: Referees, belts, relays and records: free games for kids to discover sports and their rules, on a phone, tablet or computer, then playable offline.
univers.sport.intro: On this page, sports are the subject of the game, whatever the way of playing: you can compete in an event, but also answer questions about a discipline, find the equipment for each sport or learn the rules of a match. Soccer, swimming, skiing, gymnastics, track and field or martial arts: each sport has its vocabulary, its moves and its values. You learn what a referee, a belt, a relay or a record is, and you discover team spirit and respect for your opponent. A game about the sport a child plays often makes the next practice more concrete; another may spark the wish to try a new activity.

univers.cuisine.h1: Cooking games: cakes, recipes and baking
univers.cuisine.titre_seo: Free cooking games for kids: bake cakes, follow recipes
univers.cuisine.description_seo: Make cakes, pizzas or smoothies step by step: free cooking games for kids on a phone, tablet or computer, and playable offline afterwards as well.
univers.cuisine.intro: Flour, eggs, fruit, frosting and chocolate chips: the screen becomes a kitchen counter. Follow a recipe, decorate a cake, serve hurried customers or sort foods into groups: each game has its own way of getting into the kitchen. The order of the steps, remembering ingredients, measuring quantities and, when orders pile up, organization all come into play. You can also talk about balanced eating, fruits and vegetables in season or dishes from other countries. A simple recipe made together after the game, like a fruit salad or pancakes, takes you from the screen to the real kitchen, tasting included.

age.3-4.titre_seo: Easy free games for 3 and 4 year olds: tap and play
age.3-4.description_seo: At 3 and 4, kids play with a fingertip: colors, shapes, animals and sounds in easy free games on a phone, tablet or computer, then offline too.
age.3-4.intro: At 3 or 4, a child discovers the screen with their fingers: they tap, swipe and watch what happens. The games gathered here are recommended from this age. They rely on simple gestures, clearly visible pictures and short instructions, to recognize colors, shapes, animals or sounds, match pairs or count a few objects. Having a grown-up nearby is still valuable: reading the instruction out loud, encouraging, naming what appears on screen. At this age, a few minutes of play is plenty. And since a game opened once with the internet can then be replayed offline, it can also fill a car trip or a moment in a waiting room.

age.5-6.titre_seo: Games for kids aged 5 and 6: free learning games to play
age.5-6.description_seo: Letters, numbers, memory, logic and first challenges: games recommended from age 5 or 6, on a phone, tablet or PC, then offline once opened.
age.5-6.intro: Between 5 and 6, children are starting school in earnest: they recognize letters, begin to read, count higher and higher and love taking on challenges. All the games on this page are recommended from age 5 or 6. Many combine several small rules, level-by-level progress and stars to earn, which makes you want to try again to do better. Memory, attention, logic, precise movements and the first things learned at school all get a chance to practice. Some instructions still need a little help with reading: a grown-up or an older sibling can read them the first time, then let the child spread their wings.

age.7-8.titre_seo: Free online games for kids aged 7 and 8: a step up
age.7-8.description_seo: Riddles, strategy, reflexes and general knowledge: more demanding games, recommended from age 7 or 8, on a phone, tablet or PC, then offline.
age.7-8.intro: Reading a short instruction alone, counting with ease, following a rule with several steps: around 7 or 8, most children can do this, and the games for this age group make the most of it. Longer levels, puzzles that take several moves, time management, little strategies or general knowledge questions: the difficulty goes up a notch. Reasoning, concentration, speed and perseverance improve, because beating a tough level sometimes takes several tries. These games are happily played independently, with a grown-up nearby, ready to admire the level finally beaten.

age.9+.h1: Games for kids aged 9 and up
age.9+.titre_seo: Free games for kids aged 9 and up: real challenges to beat
age.9+.description_seo: For ages 9 and up, free games that put up a fight: brain teasers, strategy, speed and trivia on a phone, tablet or PC, even offline later on.
age.9+.intro: From age 9, players like a game that pushes back. The games recommended from this age offer brain teasers that require thinking several moves ahead, strategy and management, courses that demand precise reflexes, or tougher quizzes. The difficulty rises from level to level, and beating your own record becomes a goal in itself. Planning, logical thinking, handling mistakes and patience come out stronger. These games are still designed for kids: no realistic violence or frightening scenes, no contact with strangers. Teens and adults can test themselves too, and a player this age is perfectly entitled to go back to games for younger kids to relax.
